title: Fact or Fiction: Verifying Scientific Claims
checked_claim: SciFact separates abstract retrieval, stance classification and sentence rationale selection.
limits: Small curated corpus; abstract evidence; test labels withheld in official README. A source stance is not scientific validity.
project_relevance: Reference contract for source-relative verification with citations.
reuse_status: Code, dataset and checkpoint download instructions inspected; not installed or downloaded. Audit shared claims/documents before evaluation.
license_status: Official LICENSE.md: claims/annotations CC BY 4.0; abstracts ODC-By 1.0; code Apache-2.0.

title: SciFact-Open: Towards open-domain scientific claim verification
type: primary conference paper and test collection
checked_claim: A 500K-abstract collection exposes reduced transfer and evidence supporting restricted claim scope.
limits: Pooled judgments are incomplete; absence of an annotation is not a biological negative.
project_relevance: Motivates coverage and narrower-context accounting when expanding retrieval.
reuse_status: Data download and evaluation instructions inspected. Python 3.8.5-era environment; no download. Audit SciFact-derived claim exposure.
license_status: No explicit repository-wide license found in inspected top-level material; dataset/source terms need resolution before redistribution.

title: MultiVerS: Improving scientific claim verification with weak supervision and full-document context
checked_claim: Joint document stance and sentence rationales share document context.
limits: Does not establish trial arithmetic, full-text table handling, scientific validity or transfer to CRC.
project_relevance: Concrete three-way-plus-rationale baseline candidate already noted in our feasibility audit.
reuse_status: Checkpoints linked; not downloaded. Python 3.8, Torch 1.7.1, Transformers 4.2.2. FEVER, PubMedQA, Evidence Inference and target-dataset training require overlap audit.
license_status: MIT code confirmed; underlying datasets/checkpoints require separate provenance review.

title: Evidence Inference 2.0: More Data, Better Models
type: primary conference paper and clinical evidence dataset
checked_claim: Trial-result direction is conditioned on intervention, comparator and outcome with evidence annotations.
limits: No significant difference is not NEI; study-local outcome inference is not evidence synthesis or complete population modeling.
project_relevance: Established framing for our wrong-arm and endpoint-binding gap.
reuse_status: Annotation/code paths inspected; ready-to-run inference checkpoint not verified. Audit PMID overlap with other biomedical training data.
license_status: MIT software license inspected; source-article rights remain distinct.

title: A Corpus with Multi-Level Annotations of Patients, Interventions and Outcomes to Support Language Processing for Medical Literature
type: primary conference paper and extraction corpus
checked_claim: EBM-NLP supplies trial-abstract PIO spans and finer labels with crowd/expert annotation distinctions.
limits: Span recognition does not bind outcomes to treatment arms. Official hierarchical-label test caveat concerns supplied crowd-derived spans.
project_relevance: Existing extraction annotation scheme, not a new semantic truth benchmark.
reuse_status: Repository/readme and download guidance inspected; no annotations consumed. PMID overlap audit needed.
license_status: Definitive artifact-wide license not identified in inspected official material; do not infer permission from public availability.

title: NLI4CT: Multi-Evidence Natural Language Inference for Clinical Trial Reports
checked_claim: Binary clinical-section inference includes cross-trial and numerical operations; gold-evidence-only baselines did not significantly solve inference.
limits: No NEI class; supplied sections differ from open literature retrieval; benchmark conventions and model exposure matter.
project_relevance: Already evaluated, not a fresh recommendation. Retain separate false-support and trial-family analyses.
reuse_status: Existing pinned FLAN runtime and consumed 500-case test retained. Train/dev are checkpoint-exposed; no rerun here.
license_status: Project already retains Apache-2.0 release notice and source attribution; model and runtime terms tracked separately.

title: SemEval-2024 Task 2: Safe Biomedical Natural Language Inference for Clinical Trials
type: primary shared-task paper and perturbation benchmark
checked_claim: NLI4CT-P tests preserving and altering interventions on benchmark statements.
limits: Shares original test roots; appended-definition neutrality is task-specific; erratum and implementation issues require explicit scoring.
project_relevance: Already measured robustness; cannot call its 5,000 consumed variants an independent future holdout.
reuse_status: Existing pinned release, corrected scoring and historical results preserved; no new examples consumed.
license_status: Pinned project release uses Apache-2.0 with ClinicalTrials.gov attribution; paper/erratum distinct.

title: Evaluating Language Models for Biomedical Fact-Checking: A Benchmark Dataset for Cancer Variant Interpretation Verification
type: primary preprint, versioned dataset and models
checked_claim: Structured cancer-variant claims are paired with curated full-text evidence and augmented examples for curation auditing.
limits: Later preprint/specification revisions differ; current REVISIONS label is not the checkpoint's REFUTES class. Curation agreement is not clinical truth.
project_relevance: Already integrated/evaluated; preserve failed results and expert disagreement rather than reuse development labels as gold holdout.
reuse_status: Official model card and current specification inspected. PMC full-page access blocked; indexed primary text available. Exact model/dataset revisions already pinned locally.
license_status: Model card MIT; evidence inherits article-specific licenses. Specification states full v2025.03.25 build's most restrictive license is CC BY-NC-SA.

title: MedCPT: Contrastive Pre-trained Transformers with large-scale PubMed search logs for zero-shot biomedical information retrieval
type: primary journal paper and retrieval models
checked_claim: Query/article encoders plus cross-encoder reranking are trained for biomedical retrieval.
limits: Retrieval relevance does not establish support. Private user logs prevent complete training-membership inspection.
project_relevance: Candidate against our lexical retrieval only if retrieval coverage is the diagnosed gap.
reuse_status: Official code, public checkpoint links and usage inspected; no installation or embedding/index build. Training logs are not released.
license_status: NCBI public-domain software/database notice inspected; article corpus rights remain separate.

title: A dataset for evaluating clinical research claims in large language models
checked_claim: CliniFact derives clinical-research claims from hypothesis-testing results and registry data.
limits: Construction detail only partially inspected due publisher access failure; class mapping, source access and overlap unresolved.
project_relevance: Screened additional reference candidate, not yet justified for our specific cancer-claim contract.
reuse_status: Primary indexed abstract/code-availability statement and official README inspected; not downloaded or run. Require NCT/claim-family overlap audit.
license_status: Official README declares MIT; source-specific rights and exact release packaging require follow-up.

title: MS²: Multi-Document Summarization of Medical Studies
type: primary conference paper, dataset and models
checked_claim: Review-linked study collections enable biomedical multi-document summarization research.
limits: Official Evidence Inference adaptation discards comparator; generated synthesis is not a risk-of-bias or clinical-validity assessment.
project_relevance: Later-stage synthesis reference; not a ready repair for our wrong-arm errors.
reuse_status: Code and BART/LED/EI checkpoint links inspected; authors recommend cleaned MSLR data. Legacy runtime and study/review overlap need audit.
license_status: Apache-2.0 code; dataset uses separate Semantic Scholar API/Dataset License Agreement.

title: Automated Metrics for Medical Multi-Document Summarization Disagree with Human Evaluations
type: primary conference evaluation paper and annotations
checked_claim: Common automatic metric rankings disagreed with human assessments on evaluated medical summary systems.
limits: Specific systems and review summaries; does not prove every automated metric is useless or validate a replacement judge.
project_relevance: Measure claim fidelity, qualifications and omissions rather than use text similarity as scientific accuracy.
reuse_status: Paper and released annotation repository inspected; no annotated examples downloaded. Not a new verifier checkpoint.
license_status: Artifact license not conclusively checked; review-source rights require separate treatment.

title: RobotReviewer: evaluation of a system for automatically assessing bias in clinical trials
type: primary journal evaluation, published online 2015 / issue 2016
checked_claim: Joint risk-of-bias domain prediction and evidence-text extraction support trial appraisal.
limits: Original judgments trailed the human comparison; applicability is trial-appraisal assistance, not autonomous truth verification.
project_relevance: Demonstrates that credibility appraisal is a separate established task beyond NLI.
reuse_status: Official Docker/API and model-download guidance inspected; legacy Python 3.6/TensorFlow 1.12 documentation requires compatibility audit. No deployment.
license_status: GPL-3.0 code confirmed; model and source-document rights need separate checks before packaging.

title: CIViC MCP: integrating large language models with the Clinical Interpretations of Variants in Cancer
type: primary journal paper and upstream tool interface
checked_claim: Upstream MCP tools expose CIViC evidence and assertions with a released QA evaluation.
limits: README evidence response cap is 50; 100-triplet QA is retrieval/answering evaluation, not independent publication verification.
project_relevance: Compare an established upstream tool before building custom CIViC agents; preserve provenance and audit completeness.
reuse_status: Publication metadata, official repository tools/runtime guidance and license inspected; no live query or installation. Branch observed: defined_CIViC_tools.
license_status: Modified MIT license with academic citation requirement; not plain MIT. CIViC/source content terms remain separate.
